Alex — thanks for confirming. I’ve tentatively booked Mon 16 Feb 1:00–2:00pm PST and sent a calendar invite (please accept when you get it). Ben and Soojin from SE will run the session — Ben will lead the demo; Soojin will cover security/consent & data retention defaults.

Ben / Soojin — please prioritize a short slide with:
- Measured p50/p95 latency for 2k-token requests on an A100-class profile (include batching assumptions),
- Default data retention and KV cache behavior, and
- Any prerequisites for API keys & customer-side networking (IP allowlist, VPC peering notes).

Alex — would you be able to attach an anonymized sample request payload (<= 2MB) or paste a representative JSON snippet ahead of time? That will help the demo be concrete.

I’ll also share the security questionnaire (procurement) pre-call so procurement can review asynchronously.

-Jordan
Jordan Blake
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0147

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@ironpeak.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: RE: IronPeak — SE tech kickoff & engineer handoff

Alex / team — quick notes ahead of Monday:
- Latency numbers: for a single 2k-token text-gen on an A100-class profile with single-request scheduling we observe ~p50 220ms / p95 560ms when no batching. With moderate batching (batch size 4, autoconcat disabled) expect p95 ~700–850ms. I’ll include a slide with exact numbers and the test harness used.
- We’ll show an example cURL and a short Python snippet for streaming vs non-streaming usage.
- For data retention: by default Redwood stores request metadata and KV cache for 30 days in hosted mode; Private deployments can be configured to 0-day retention (customer-managed). We’ll have Soojin walk through options.

Soojin — please attach the security questionnaire PDF and the minimal checklist for procurement.

Action items before the call (Mon 1pm PST):
- Alex: paste or attach a representative request payload (Jordan — he said <=2MB).
- Jordan/Vanessa: confirm calendar attendees & time zone labels in invite.
- Ben/Soojin: slide with latency tests, sample code, and security Qs.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
